_note: Settled-water rules (Steve, river settle). feeders: a painted river head that no pond spring serves gets its own spring, sized from the drainage area the tile file stores (flow map): share of the base spring = (area km2 / full_km2) ^ p, between min_share and 1, i.e. Q = k * A^p with k = rate / full_km2^p. A head is a river cell with no higher water cell around it; one with a spring within near_cells (30 cells = 240 m) is served. stop: the settle runs in blocks and stops once the stored water has stopped changing (basins full and spilling) after min_ticks, or at max_ticks. version: bump when the rules change; settle_water prints it.
